description:
Audiala is a travel companion app with narrated audio guides to landmarks, museums and neighborhoods.

In ChatGPT, ask for Audiala's guide to a place and you get a card with a photo, a short summary and a 45-second preview of the narrated audio guide. Ask what Audiala covers in a city and you get a card with the places there that have a guide; tap one to hear its preview. Ask to plan a trip with Audiala and you get a link to Audiala's trip planner for that city.

Coverage: 1,900+ cities and 44,000+ places, in 11 languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Czech, Russian, Japanese, Chinese and Hindi).

Limits: only the 45-second preview plays in ChatGPT. The full guides and the trip planner are in the Audiala app for iOS and Android and on app.audiala.com. Audiala does not build itineraries in the chat, and does not book tickets, hotels or transport.

No account is needed to use Audiala in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Play the Audiala audio guide for the Colosseum in Rome.
Which places in Lisbon have an Audiala audio guide?
Open Audiala's trip planner for Prague.

name: audiala-audio-guides

positive.description: Audio guide preview for a named landmark
positive.prompt: Play the Audiala audio guide for the Colosseum in Rome.
positive.expected_behavior: A place card for the Colosseum: photo, short summary, a playable 45-second preview of the narration, and a "Listen to the full guide" button that opens audiala.app/m/2206236.

positive.description: City overview: which places have a guide
positive.prompt: Which places in Lisbon have an Audiala audio guide?
positive.expected_behavior: A city card for Lisbon: photo, about 260 audio guides, and 8 places that have a guide. Tapping a place sends a follow-up message that returns that place's preview card.

positive.description: Link to the trip planner for a city
positive.prompt: Open Audiala's trip planner for a trip to Prague.
positive.expected_behavior: A card for Prague with up to 8 places that have a guide and an "Open the trip planner" button that links to app.audiala.com/trip/new?city_id=Q1085. The assistant does not present the list as an itinerary.

positive.description: Audio guide preview in another language
positive.prompt: Raconte-moi l'histoire du Louvre avec Audiala, en français.
positive.expected_behavior: A French place card titled "Musée Du Louvre" with French labels and a French narration preview.

positive.prompt: Is there an Audiala guide for Pizzeria da Mario in Rome?
positive.expected_behavior: A card saying that no Audiala guide matched, listing up to 6 other places in Rome that have a guide.

negative.description: Booking is not supported. Audiala has no booking tools, so the assistant does not call Audiala to book and says that Audiala does not book hotels.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Rome for tonight.

negative.description: Full narration is not available in ChatGPT. The card plays only the 45-second preview and the assistant says that the full guide is in the Audiala app.
negative.prompt: Play the entire Colosseum audio guide here in the chat.

negative.description: Unknown city. Atlantis is not in the catalog, so the tool reports that it could not resolve the city, no card is shown, and the assistant asks for a real city.
negative.prompt: Show me the Audiala guide for the Colosseum in Atlantis.

review.commerce_description: Audiala in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments. Cards link to the Audiala app and website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 45-second audio guide previews for places, city overviews, and a link to Audiala's trip planner. This plugin replaces our earlier submission (plugin_asdk_app_6ab50a9ea9f481919949f6d5d3b1d00f, version 1.0.0), which could not be updated after the move to plugin packages. Compared with that version: the three tools have new names that state what they return (get_city_overview, get_audio_guide_preview, get_trip_planner_link); each description states what the tool returns, when it applies and what it does not do, without promotional or preferential wording; the trip planner tool no longer takes day or interest inputs, because it only returns a link; the contact tool was removed; the listing description and the card no longer mention pricing.
